{{Quote|Warden team leader TM-09, requesting Republic assistance. Subordinate droids have been compromised; inmate containment endangered.|TM-09|<ref name="UA">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]|Unexpected Assistance|[[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]}}</ref>}}
'''TM-09''' was the designation of a [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] tasked as a warden team leader on the [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]]. Stationed in [[the Tomb]] section of [[Belsavis prison]] around [[3641 BBY]], it requested assistance from a Republic citizen after his subordinate droids were reprogrammed by the [[Esh-kha]] and asked to reprogram them back.
